The fourth-down τ estimand (S1) uses inverse optimization to infer coach risk-taking behavior under win probability thresholds, modeled via bootstrap confidence intervals. Drive-level complementary features (S4) combine turnover indicators and field position into ordinal regression models predicting expected points, leveraging historical data from 2015–2024. Schedule rest differentials (S3) capture temporal scheduling impacts via day-rest bins derived from nflverse and betting data. Each primitive operates within distinct but overlapping domains—risk, drive dynamics, and temporal scheduling—enabling cross-layer integration in GSI's Bayesian framework and GSE’s state-transition logic.
